Illustrative profiles not calibrated actual drivers or FIA rule decisions

limitations: Scripted external observations, no closed-loop race, full lateral/longitudinal vehicle dynamics, actual track geometry, collision response or sporting pass adjudication.
No real 2012 calibration, actual driver psychology, live performance benchmark, cross-platform bitwise proof or game save/replay.
Conservative stationary fallback can deadlock and is not an acceleration-limited motion controller. Attack latch checks frozen current space and per-tick swept geometry, not full future prediction.
No independent scientific review, artifact ZIP reinspection, branch protection change, FULL or game approval.
rollback: Revert affected isolated PR after review, preserve adverse runs and invalidate closure if any non-manifest code/test/doc change. No automatic game integration.
